verdict.rationale: Persona publishes a public API reference for integrating identity verification. It covers pre-creating inquiries, polling statuses and fetching verification details, and a backend-only Transactions API, plus API-key IP allowlisting, sandbox simulate actions for programmatic testing, and an llms.txt with instructions for AI agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, explicit documentation of API authentication and endpoint coverage beyond select resources.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Persona API is a powerful tool that enables you to integrate identity verification, risk assessment, and compliance solutions into your applications.
Use the API to pre-create inquiries before directing users through the inquiry flow for information collection and verification.
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
Transactions API | backend-only verification APIs, no Persona UI | Fully custom UI or backend-only verification flows
replicating the necessary conditions required for programmatically testing the behavior of your application.
